<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">提高开发效率：</strong> 团队可以并行开发和部署服务，减少相互等待和协调的时间。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">加速发布周期：</strong> 独立部署使得新功能可以更快地推向市场，降低了发布风险。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">增强系统弹性：</strong> 一个服务的故障不会轻易蔓延到其他服务，提高了系统的整体可用性。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">技术选择自由：</strong> 团队可以根据业务需求选择最合适的技术，避免了技术栈的单一性限制。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">简化维护：</strong> 服务的独立性使得问题定位和修复更加容易，降低了维护成本。</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">实现服务自治的挑战与策略：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">数据一致性：</strong> 独立数据存储引入了跨服务数据一致性的挑战。通常通过事件驱动架构、最终一致性或Saga模式来解决。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">服务间通信：</strong> 服务间通信需要通过明确的API契约进行，避免直接的数据共享。使用HTTP/REST、gRPC或消息队列等轻量级通信机制。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">服务发现与注册：</strong> 独立部署的服务需要一种机制来发现彼此。服务注册中心（如Eureka、Consul）和API网关是常见的解决方案。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">配置管理：</strong> 独立服务的配置需要集中管理，以便在不同环境中进行灵活配置。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">监控与日志：</strong> 独立服务需要统一的监控和日志收集系统，以便全面了解系统运行状况。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="10" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.2.3 去中心化治理</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">去中心化治理（Decentralized Governance）是微服务架构的另一个重要原则，它与传统的集中式治理形成对比。在微服务环境中，没有一个单一的、中央化的团队或工具来强制所有服务遵循相同的技术栈、开发流程或部署策略。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心思想：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">团队自治与决策权：</strong> 每个微服务团队拥有对其服务技术栈、开发工具、数据存储和部署方式的决策权。团队根据自身服务的具体需求和业务目标做出最佳选择。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">技术异构性：</strong> 鼓励不同服务采用不同的技术栈（Polyglot Persistence/Programming），只要这些技术能够有效地解决问题并满足业务需求。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">标准与指导：</strong> 虽然没有强制性的中央控制，但通常会通过提供最佳实践、共享库、模板和架构指导等方式来促进一致性和互操作性。例如，可以提供一个推荐的日志框架或API设计规范，但允许团队在有充分理由的情况下偏离。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">沟通与协作：</strong> 强调团队之间的横向沟通和协作，通过分享经验、解决共同问题来推动整个系统的演进，而不是通过自上而下的命令。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">演进式架构：</strong> 架构被视为一个持续演进的过程，而不是一次性设计。团队可以根据反馈和学习不断调整和优化其服务。</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">去中心化治理的好处：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">提高灵活性和创新性：</strong> 团队可以自由选择最适合的技术，促进技术创新和实验。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">加速开发和部署：</strong> 减少了中央审批和协调的瓶颈，提高了开发效率和发布速度。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">增强团队责任感：</strong> 团队对自己的服务拥有完全的控制权和责任，提高了团队的积极性。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">避免技术锁定：</strong> 不会因为单一技术栈的限制而阻碍系统的发展。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">适应快速变化：</strong> 能够更好地适应业务和技术环境的快速变化。</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">去中心化治理的挑战与策略：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">技术蔓延：</strong> 过度的技术异构性可能导致技术栈过于分散，增加维护和招聘的难度。需要通过技术雷达、内部开源等方式进行引导。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">一致性问题：</strong> 缺乏中央控制可能导致服务间的不一致性，如API风格、错误处理、监控标准等。可以通过制定软性指导原则、提供共享库和工具来缓解。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">知识共享：</strong> 不同团队使用不同技术栈可能导致知识孤岛。需要建立有效的知识共享机制，如内部技术分享会、文档平台等。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">安全与合规：</strong> 去中心化不意味着放弃安全和合规。需要建立统一的安全策略和审计机制，确保所有服务都符合要求。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="11" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.2.4 故障隔离与容错设计</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">在分布式微服务架构中，任何一个服务都可能发生故障。为了确保整个系统的稳定性和可用性，<strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">故障隔离（Failure Isolation）</strong> 和 <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">容错设计（Fault Tolerance Design）</strong> 变得至关重要。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心思想：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">隔离故障：</strong> 将系统划分为独立的、隔离的组件，使得一个组件的故障不会影响到其他组件。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">快速失败：</strong> 当服务调用失败时，应该快速返回错误，而不是长时间等待或重试，从而避免资源耗尽。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">优雅降级：</strong> 当核心服务不可用时，系统应该能够提供部分功能或简化功能，而不是完全停止服务。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">自动恢复：</strong> 系统应该具备自动检测故障并尝试恢复的能力，减少人工干预。</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">常见的故障隔离与容错模式：</strong></p>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">1. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">断路器模式（Circuit Breaker Pattern）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">原理：</strong> 监控对外部服务的调用。当失败率达到一定阈值时，断路器会"打开"，阻止后续调用。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">实现：</strong> .NET中广泛使用Polly库来实现断路器模式。</li>
</ul>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">2. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">舱壁模式（Bulkhead Pattern）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">原理：</strong> 类似于船只的防水舱壁，将资源（如线程池、连接池）隔离。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">实现：</strong> 在.NET中，可以使用Polly库来配置独立的执行策略。</li>
</ul>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">3. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">超时与重试（Timeout and Retry）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">超时：</strong> 为所有远程调用设置合理的超时时间。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">重试：</strong> 对于瞬时故障，配置重试机制，但需注意幂等性和指数退避。</li>
</ul>
</ol>
<h3 id="12" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.2.5 可观测性设计原则</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">在微服务架构中，<strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">可观测性（Observability）</strong> 成为了成功的关键要素。可观测性是指系统能够通过其外部输出来推断其内部状态的能力。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">可观测性的三大支柱：</strong></p>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">1. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">日志（Logging）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">目的：</strong> 记录应用程序事件，用于故障排查和审计。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">最佳实践：</strong> 使用结构化日志、包含上下文信息、集中式日志系统。</li>
</ul>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">2. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">指标（Metrics）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">目的：</strong> 收集系统数值数据，用于趋势分析和监控。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">常见指标：</strong> RED指标（Rate, Errors, Duration）、USE方法。</li>
</ul>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">3. <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">分布式追踪（Tracing）：</strong></li>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">目的：</strong> 跟踪请求在分布式系统中的完整路径。</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心概念：</strong> Span、Trace、Correlation ID。</li>
</ul>
</ol>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">可观测性的重要性：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">快速故障排查：</strong> 迅速定位分布式系统中的问题根源</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">性能优化：</strong> 识别系统中的性能瓶颈</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">理解系统行为：</strong> 深入了解服务间的交互和依赖关系</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">支持业务决策：</strong> 通过业务指标提供数据支持</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="13" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">1.3 微服务架构模式</h2>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">微服务架构需要一系列成熟的架构模式来支撑其复杂性。这些模式是业界在实践中总结出的最佳实践。</p>
<h3 id="14" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.3.1 API Gateway 模式</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">API Gateway作为所有客户端请求的单一入口点，负责请求路由、聚合、认证、授权、限流等操作。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心功能：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">请求路由：</strong> 根据请求路径将请求路由到相应的后端微服务</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">请求聚合：</strong> 聚合多个后端服务的响应，减少客户端网络往返</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">横切关注点：</strong> 集中处理认证、授权、限流、熔断等</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">协议转换：</strong> 将外部HTTP请求转换为内部gRPC等协议</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">.NET实现方案：</strong> Ocelot、YARP (Yet Another Reverse Proxy)</p>
<h3 id="15" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.3.2 CQRS 模式</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">CQRS（Command Query Responsibility Segregation）将应用程序的读操作和写操作分离到不同的模型中。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心概念：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">命令（Command）：</strong> 改变系统状态的写操作</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">查询（Query）：</strong> 获取系统状态的读操作</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">读模型：</strong> 专门为查询优化的数据模型</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">写模型：</strong> 专门为命令优化的领域模型</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">适用场景：</strong> 读写负载差异大、复杂业务领域、与事件溯源结合</p>
<h3 id="16" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1.3.3 Saga 模式</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">Saga模式是处理分布式事务的关键模式，通过一系列本地事务来维护跨服务的数据一致性。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">核心思想：</strong></p>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">本地事务：</strong> 每个服务执行自己的本地事务，保证本地一致性</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">事件驱动：</strong> 通过领域事件触发下一个业务步骤</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">补偿事务：</strong> 失败时执行补偿操作撤销之前的事务</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; text-indent: -1em; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">最终一致性：</strong> 实现最终一致性而非强一致性</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">Saga类型对比：</strong></p>
<section style="padding: 0 8px; max-width: 100%; overflow: auto">
